integration_decision.name: SEQUENTIAL_SPAWN_STAGE_VALIDATED; CONTROLLED_INTERLEAVING_STILL_UNTESTED
integration_decision.new_finding: Exact new 112-line test uses two separately spawned children but runs them strictly sequentially: child A completes before rowB is appended and child B starts. This verifies process-spawn viability, archive 0/0 -> 1/1 and nested PIT rowB provenance, not overlapping publication or three-file generation coherence. It queues full anata_output rather than only minimal provenance; stage-2 child messages should be bounded to counters, nested source_record_id/role, error strings and exit codes.
integration_decision.source_mechanism: runner.run_once loads a snapshot, then separately calls runner.atomic_write_json on latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json. storage.load_observations locks only the read; storage.atomic_write_json uses per-file os.replace. No whole-generation lock or cross-file transaction is established by these blobs. Stale overwrite remains a test hypothesis, not a reproduced production defect.
integration_decision.bounded_next_test_contract: TEST-ONLY on exact SHA. Reuse top-level spawn child target, same shared tmp_path and T=1700000000000; child A runs no-network on empty archive and test-only wraps runner.atomic_write_json, signalling Event when about to publish anata_latest.json and waiting on release_A with a bounded timeout. Parent waits for A_paused, appends PIT-visible BTC ETF rowB (effective=T-2000, available=observed=T-1000), starts independent B and waits for B exit=0, 1/1 counts, nested role=scoring and source_record_id=rowB. Parent parses and snapshots bytes of latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json after B. In finally release A and terminate/join survivors; require A exit=0, A 0/0, all final JSON parse, final three bytes equal B snapshots and persisted rowB provenance. Do not use sleeps as timing oracle, skip, xfail, or production edits; distinguish fixture/timeout/executor JSON failures from a confirmed race.
